adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the code was refactored to treat `calendarReference` as an array (`filter(...)` and then iterating `for (const reference of calendarReference)`), indicating multiple `_calendar` references can exist per booking. However, in the merge-path (`if (newBookingId) { ... }`) it still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`, which will select only one calendar reference. If multiple per-host `_calendar` references now exist (e.g., collective/team events), only one old event would be deleted and the others would remain orphaned.
